messages:
neha: Heads up — onboarding mistral-lite-v2 int4 shows weird padding tokens propagating into outputs when context > 2048. First noticed on summarization eval. Repro attached.

sam: Can you paste the minimal repro + model config? is this on Redwood hosted or private deploy?

neha: private (local Docker, runtime v0.9.2). Model: mistral-lite-v2 converted -> int4 with our quant shim. rotary_mode=headwise, proj_order=qkv, pad_token=1

neha: repro:
```
# run locally
python serve_infer.py --model ./mistral-lite-v2-int4 --input 'Summarize: <long doc>' --max_tokens 256
```

neha: Outputs look fine <=1024 but after 2048 padding tokens start leaking into beam outputs: "<pad>" tokens repeated and weird attention spikes.

zack: can you run diff against llama-mini int4 on same prompt? curious if this is conversion artifact or quant/kernel mismatch.

neha: did that: llama-mini int4 no issue. quick perf numbers: same node cpu/GPU: llama time 1.2s, mistral int4 1.15s but quality (ROUGE) -6.7 vs fp32 baseline.

sam: Ping @eng-ml-bot to collect kv cache dumps and rotary matmul traces.

eng-ml-bot: collecting artifacts... please wait :hourglass: (artifact id: a-2026-03-23-09)

neha: attaching small kvcache dump (snippet) and attention weights sample:
```
KV.shape = (batch=1, heads=32, seq=3072, dim=64)
attention peak @pos 2049 -> 2053
rotary_scale per-head shows abrupt jump on head 7
```

zack: This smells like wraparound bug in our KV caching when seq > model.max_pos after conversion. Could be token id remap where pad id 1 got mapped to eos leading to prefix caching. I'll bisect conversion script next.

sam: For triage: 1) confirm vocab mapping table (pad/eos) 2) run float32 fp32 inference on same conversion (no quant) to see if issue persists 3) run single-head rotary check with small seq to isolate proj order.

neha: doing 1) now — pad mapped from 0->1 by converter (uh). 2) float32 baseline looks okay (no pad leak). So likely quant conversion remap bug.

sam: ok can we rollback converter commit? @zack can you x-check commit 9c1b? If confirmed, we should hotfix converter and add an onboard unit test: longctx pad-propagation.

zack: I'll revert and run CI. Also adding test: generate 3k token sequence with inserted pads and assert no pad in generated tokens beyond prompt.

neha: TY — saved my sanity :pray: Keep thread for rollout notes + postmortem if needed.

eng-ml-bot: update: artifacts collected -> /artifacts/a-2026-03-23-09.zip
